The issue is that the system expects exact tags. We need to produce a single action call. Let's ensure correct formatting:

<thought>We need to validate the route JSON.</thought>
<action>verify_route</action>
<action_input>{"route":"{\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"COc1ccc(C(=CH2)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1\", \"children\": [{\"type\": \"reaction\", \"template_id\": 1679747, \"children\": [{\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"COc1ccc(C(=O)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1\"}, {\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"[Li]C[Si](C)(C)C\"}]}]}"}"</action_input>

But note the extra quote after the outer brace. The outer JSON ends with } then the outer string ends with " then } . So we need:

{"route":"{...}"} . No extra quote after outer }. So:

<action_input>{"route":"{\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"COc1ccc(C(=CH2)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1\", \"children\": [{\"type\": \"reaction\", \"template_id\": 1679747, \"children\": [{\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"COc1ccc(C(=O)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1\"}, {\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"[Li]C[Si](C)(C)C\"}]}]}"}"</action_input>

Again extra quote after }". Actually the outer JSON string ends with " after the escaped inner JSON, then close outer brace. So correct is:

{"route":"{\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"COc1ccc(C(=CH2)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1\", \"children\": [{\"type\": \"reaction\", \"template_id\": 1679747, \"children\": [{\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"COc1ccc(C(=O)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1\"}, {\"type\": \"mol\", \"smiles\": \"[Li]C[Si](C)(C)C\"}]}]}"}

Thus the action_input should be that JSON. Let's produce.
